name: The Tho Yor gather the first Force adepts on Tython
summary: Eight great pyramid ships, the Tho Yor, carried Force-sensitive pilgrims from across the galaxy to the Deep Core world of Tython. Their descendants founded the Je'daii Order, the philosophical root of both the Jedi and, much later, the Sith.

name: Rise of the Rakatan Infinite Empire
summary: The Rakata of Lehon fused the dark side of the Force with technology to build the first hyperdrives, which could only reach worlds strong in the Force. Over several thousand years they enslaved hundreds of such worlds and ruled them as the Infinite Empire.

name: The Star Forge is built over Lehon
summary: At the height of their power the Rakata built the Star Forge, a factory station that drew matter from Lehon's sun and fleets from the dark side of its builders. It would outlive its makers by twenty-five thousand years.

name: Rakata enslave the future Core and Rim worlds

location.note: also Corellia, Duro, Kashyyyk, Tatooine, Dantooine, Honoghr, Manaan

summary: Coruscant, Corellia, Duro, Kashyyyk, Dantooine and many other worlds that later shaped the Republic spent millennia as Rakatan slave colonies. The Infinite Empire's Star Maps on these planets were the trail Revan followed to the Star Forge.

name: Force Wars on Tython
summary: The Je'daii split over whether to follow the light or the dark, and a decade of war scoured Tython. The victors left the Deep Core and reorganised themselves as the Jedi Order, devoted to the light alone.

name: Founding of the Jedi Order
summary: In the aftermath of the Force Wars the surviving light-side adepts formed the Jedi Order, swearing to serve as guardians rather than rulers. Within a few centuries they had left Tython for Ossus and allied themselves with the young Republic.

name: Plague cuts the Rakata off from the Force
summary: A plague that killed only Rakata swept the Infinite Empire, and the survivors found they could no longer touch the Force. Their Force-keyed technology failed with them, and their slave worlds rose in revolt.

name: Collapse of the Infinite Empire
summary: Stripped of the Force and besieged by slave uprisings, the Rakata withdrew to Lehon and fell into civil war that bombed their own world back to savagery. The Star Forge was left idle in orbit, forgotten by everyone but the dying machine itself.

name: The Rakata glass Tatooine
summary: When Tatooine's Kumumgah slaves rebelled during the empire's collapse, the Rakata bombarded the planet from orbit until its forests and oceans were burned into the desert that later generations knew.

name: The Hutts crush Xim the Despot at Vontor
summary: Xim the Despot, master of the Tion Cluster, met the Hutt Empire's armies in three battles at Vontor and lost the last of them decisively. The Hutts took Xim captive and ended Tionese expansion, leaving the Tion as a brittle collection of successor states.

name: Corellians and Duros perfect the hyperdrive
summary: Working from Rakatan wreckage, engineers of Corellia and Duro built the first hyperdrives that did not depend on the Force. For the first time any world, not just the strong-in-the-Force, could be reached, and the Core began to knit itself together.

name: Unification Wars of the Core
summary: Coruscant fought a series of wars and absorbed its rivals as the Core Worlds reorganised after Rakatan rule. The settlement that ended them became the founding compact of the Galactic Republic.

name: The Perlemian Trade Route is blazed
summary: Explorers opened a stable hyperlane from Coruscant east through Brentaal toward Ossus, the first of the great trade routes. It bound the eastern Core to Coruscant and gave the Jedi of Ossus a road to the capital.

name: The Corellian Run is blazed
summary: Corellian scouts opened a second great hyperlane running south-east from Coruscant through Corellia toward the Rim. With the Perlemian it formed the wedge of settled space called the Slice, the Republic's heartland for thousands of years.
